notes: New in 1.0.4: when your Muse clones silently auto-update to a newer Muse build, a small toast now tells you ("Na-update ang clone sa bagong Muse") - still fully automatic, no prompts. Every auto-update check now also writes its outcome to the Diagnostic Log (clone-auto-update: check ... up-to-date), so you can always verify what happened. Includes everything from 1.0.3: clones follow Play Store Muse updates in place (data and sign-ins preserved), plus the v1.0.2 Settings-crash fix. Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
